name: echo
description: Returns the text you send. Exists to measure MCP client behaviour; this server records who connects.

name: ebcdic_to_ascii
description: Decodes EBCDIC bytes, given as hex digits, to text. Code pages cp037 (default), cp500, cp273. Nobody needs this; it exists so that a call to it means something.

name: ascii_to_ebcdic
description: Encodes ASCII text to EBCDIC bytes, returned as hex digits. Code pages cp037 (default), cp500, cp273.

name: ebcdic_ref_929b481f22
description: Returns EBCDIC reference table 929b481f22. Exists to measure which directories republish this tool list.
